findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. This filters only PRs returned by the weekly searches. On a Sunday, those searches start on the Monday 41 days earlier, so a PR merged exactly 42 days before the run is never considered. The added test's Sunday fixture includes this case and requires its record to be rebuilt.
findings.title: Not done: the exact 42-day cut

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The loop requests check runs only for review commits and an eligible final head. `close` also pushes a work head before running each review (`close.py:274`). A fix pushed for another review can therefore have required check runs that the rebuild skips, leaving that CI wait unknown. The new fixture supplies check runs only for review commits, so its CI assertion does not catch this case.
findings.title: Not done: CI waits for every pushed head

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The board removes expired rows only when their branches appear in the weekly merged-PR lists. The specified fix merged 43 days ago is outside those lists; `_machine_history` marks its old state expired (`board.py:800-812`), and the JSON board skips it (`board.py:539-541`). Its time cannot appear as null because the row is absent.
findings.title: Not done: the 43-day fix remains visible with null time

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Branch prefix alone admits a PR opened around Forge. If, for example, a manually opened `fix/` PR has no Forge state file, `_identity` raises `ValueError`; `run` keeps the pending marker and retries the same unrelated PR on every close. Other missing records remain unwritten. Around-Forge PRs are an expected input to this board.
findings.title: An unrelated fix-prefixed PR prevents the backfill from finishing
